# Game Idea: Orbit Escape

Navigate a satellite around a planet on an HTML canvas. Use arrow keys to apply thrust and keep the orbit stable while dodging occasional meteor bursts. **Lose condition:** the satellite crashes into the planet or drifts off-screen.

1: // Simple Orbit Escape game
2: // Canvas with id="game" expected in HTML
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Audio assets
8:   const thrustSound = new Audio('thrust.wav');
9:   const explosionSound = new Audio('explosion.wav');
10:   const bgMusic = new Audio('background.mp3');
11:   bgMusic.loop = true;
12:   bgMusic.volume = 0.3;
13:   bgMusic.play().catch(() => {});
14:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
15:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
16:   // generate starfield once
17:   const stars = [];
18:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
19:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height, r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5 });
20:   }
21: 
22:   // Planet at centre with gradient
23:   const planet = { x: width / 2, y: height / 2, r: 40 };
24:   const planetGradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(planet.x, planet.y, planet.r * 0.2, planet.x, planet.y, planet.r);
25:   planetGradient.addColorStop(0, '#88ff88');
26:   planetGradient.addColorStop(1, '#226622');
27: 
28:   // Satellite state
29:   const sat = {
30:     x: planet.x + 120,
31:     y: planet.y,
32:     vx: 0,
33:     vy: -1.5,
34:     size: 8
35:   };
36: 
37:   // Thrust parameters
38:   const THRUST = 0.05;
39: 
40:   // Meteor pool
41:   const meteors = [];
42:   const METEOR_INTERVAL = 2000; // ms
43:   const METEOR_SPEED = 2;
44:   let lastMeteor = 0;
45: 
46:   let gameOver = false;
47:   let explosionPlayed = false;
48: 
49:   // Input handling
50:   const keys = {};
51:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; if (['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight'].includes(e.key)) { thrustSound.currentTime = 0; thrustSound.play().catch(() => {}); } });
52:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
53: 
54:   function spawnMeteor() {
55:     // Choose random edge
56:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
57:     let x, y, vx, vy;
58:     if (edge === 0) { // top
59:       x = Math.random() * width; y = -10; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * METEOR_SPEED; vy = METEOR_SPEED;
60:     } else if (edge === 1) { // right
61:       x = width + 10; y = Math.random() * height; vx = -METEOR_SPEED; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * METEOR_SPEED;
62:     } else if (edge === 2) { // bottom
63:       x = Math.random() * width; y = height + 10; vx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * METEOR_SPEED; vy = -METEOR_SPEED;
64:     } else { // left
65:       x = -10; y = Math.random() * height; vx = METEOR_SPEED; vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * METEOR_SPEED;
66:     }
67:     meteors.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r: 6 });
68:   }
69: 
70:   function update(dt) {
71:     if (gameOver) return;
72:     // Apply thrust based on arrow keys
73:     if (keys.ArrowUp) { sat.vy -= THRUST; }
74:     if (keys.ArrowDown) { sat.vy += THRUST; }
75:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) { sat.vx -= THRUST; }
76:     if (keys.ArrowRight) { sat.vx += THRUST; }
77: 
78:     // Update position
79:     sat.x += sat.vx * dt;
80:     sat.y += sat.vy * dt;
81: 
82:     // Meteor update
83:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
84:       const m = meteors[i];
85:       m.x += m.vx * dt;
86:       m.y += m.vy * dt;
87:       // Remove off-screen meteors
88:       if (m.x < -20 || m.x > width + 20 || m.y < -20 || m.y > height + 20) {
89:         meteors.splice(i, 1);
90:       }
91:     }
92: 
93:     // Collisions
94:     const distPlanet = Math.hypot(sat.x - planet.x, sat.y - planet.y);
95:     if (distPlanet < planet.r + sat.size) gameOver = true; // crash into planet
96:     if (sat.x < 0 || sat.x > width || sat.y < 0 || sat.y > height) gameOver = true; // drift off-screen
97:     for (const m of meteors) {
98:       const d = Math.hypot(sat.x - m.x, sat.y - m.y);
99:       if (d < sat.size + m.r) { gameOver = true; break; }
100:     }
101:     // Play explosion sound once on game over
102:     if (gameOver && !explosionPlayed) {
103:       explosionSound.currentTime = 0;
104:       explosionSound.play();
105:       bgMusic.pause();
106:       explosionPlayed = true;
107:     }
108:     // Spawn meteors
109:     const now = performance.now();
110:     if (now - lastMeteor > METEOR_INTERVAL) {
111:       spawnMeteor();
112:       lastMeteor = now;
113:     }
114:   }
115: 
116:   function draw() {
117:     // Background space gradient
118:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
119:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
120:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#003');
121:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
122:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
123: 
124:     // Stars
125:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
126:     for (const s of stars) {
127:       ctx.beginPath();
128:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
129:       ctx.fill();
130:     }
131: 
132:     // Planet with gradient
133:     ctx.fillStyle = planetGradient;
134:     ctx.beginPath();
135:     ctx.arc(planet.x, planet.y, planet.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
136:     ctx.fill();
137: 
138:     // Satellite with glow
139:     const satGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(sat.x, sat.y, sat.size * 0.2, sat.x, sat.y, sat.size * 2);
140:     satGrad.addColorStop(0, '#fff');
141:     satGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
142:     ctx.fillStyle = satGrad;
143:     ctx.beginPath();
144:     ctx.arc(sat.x, sat.y, sat.size * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
145:     ctx.fill();
146:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
147:     ctx.beginPath();
148:     ctx.arc(sat.x, sat.y, sat.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
149:     ctx.fill();
150: 
151:     // Meteors with tail gradient
152:     for (const m of meteors) {
153:       const trailGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x, m.y, 0, m.x, m.y, m.r * 3);
154:       trailGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,100,100,0.8)');
155:       trailGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,100,100,0)');
156:       ctx.fillStyle = trailGrad;
157:       ctx.beginPath();
158:       ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
159:       ctx.fill();
160:       ctx.fillStyle = '#a33';
161:       ctx.beginPath();
162:       ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
163:       ctx.fill();
164:     }
165: 
166:     // Game over overlay
167:     if (gameOver) {
168:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
169:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
170:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
171:       ctx.font = '36px sans-serif';
172:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
173:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
174:     }
175:   }
176: 
177:   let last = performance.now();
178:   function loop() {
179:     const now = performance.now();
180:     const dt = (now - last) / 16; // normalize to ~60fps step
181:     last = now;
182:     update(dt);
183:     draw();
184:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
185:   }
186:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
187: })();

(End of file - total 187 lines)
</content>
